A neutral generic adult human volunteer, no celebrity likeness, shown from head to thighs in a calm bright anatomy museum on warm cream background. Believable human face, skin with pores and warm undertones, five fingers on each hand, natural proportions, modest opaque teal shorts. A freestanding transparent acrylic exhibit beside the volunteer shows clean simplified heart, lungs and branching contained vessels at correct torso level, with all red flow INSIDE vessels; no injury, no open skin, no exposed wound, no horror. Soft 5200K clinical key, gentle warm fill, subtle teal accents, realistic documentary quality, no toy plastic or cartoon. Landscape 16:9 composition suitable for a website hero, keep ample clear cream space on left for HTML text added later. No words, labels, logos, watermarks, QR codes, brands, operating tools or gore. Final art, not a UI mockup.
